recommendation: Keep the commit. Future work on the unresolved broader signature tickets can rewrite the section for clarity, but should preserve the FHIR-52810 outcome that embedded Bundle signatures target '#/' rather than Bundle/[id].
issue_request: FHIR-52810 was Applied with resolution Persuasive with Modification. It requested changing the Signing Bundles guidance because using Provenance.target = Bundle/[id] makes document signatures depend on Bundle.id, which can change as the document is transmitted; the approved resolution required pointer-based fragments and the fragment identifier '#/'.
initial_application: HL7/fhir#4028 merged as 66cbbee5f9e678f6c702807682f9bf0a064e9456 and added a ballot note saying FHIR-52810 was clarified, while nearby commit 9f8597f0a551bb5fcf4b3db6cd8071f8845de9d8 updated counter-signing wording to mention '#/'. The primary Signing Bundles rule and the Provenance worked example still used Bundle/[id]/Bundle/signed, so the application was partial.
additional_context: The Zulip Signature comments thread linked from Jira supports the rationale that non-repudiation signatures should not depend on Bundle.id. FHIR-53810 and FHIR-57443 later observed that the Bundle/[id] wording remained confusing, but they are unresolved/Triaged and were used only as context. FHIR-52811 and FHIR-53914 raise broader unresolved wording questions for the same section and do not reverse FHIR-52810.
reconciliation: Changed source/signatures.html so the Signing Bundles rule requires Provenance.target.reference exactly '#/' and describes it as the pointer-based fragment identifier for the root Bundle. Updated the worked Provenance example to use '#/' instead of Bundle/signed. No broader self-signing, counter-signing, or canonicalization text was changed.
source_changes: source/signatures.html:446-449 now defines the embedded Bundle-signature target as Provenance.target.reference '#/' rather than Bundle/[id].
source/signatures.html:511-513 now uses '#/' in the worked Provenance.target example instead of Bundle/signed.
